identity: Piltover cliffside trade-and-workshop quarter; compressed playable community is project fiction, not a canonical street map.
camera: Theatrical low three-quarter matte-painting composition, elevated horizon, readable frontal doors. Architecture uses forced depth rather than a strict isometric grid.

aerial.subject: Rotorwing/Stormwing flight-testing loft: physically supported veranda, inert rotor calibration rig, contained blue induction cells, ground-access staircase; no rider board.

guild.subject: Civic academy lecture observatory; one low teaching hall develops into a glass-and-brass instrument tower.

hall.subject: Trade council lodge developing into a grand mercantile assembly hall and civic clock tower; strong physical size at distance.

fort.subject: Terraced city gate and Warden walls with bronze-trimmed watch towers; fortified civic architecture rather than a Noxian war keep.

museum.subject: Small public museum portico at the quayside stair; civic banners and public display windows.

handlers.subject: Compact freight-machine dispatch yard; Inventor Guild office and reinforced handler service bay develop the same site.

wardens.subject: Cadet civic patrol lodge; Academy drill gallery and senior Warden barracks extend the same building.

rifles.subject: Warden rifle depot and enclosed training gallery; upgraded arsenal adds a readable upper gallery.

silo.subject: Narrow hextech materials workshop with an opaque stone base and a small protected blue-crystal reservoir.

artificers.subject: Academy craft hall and engineered crossbow testing gallery; scholarly tools and brass lattice windows.

lifters.subject: Rampager/Dreadnought research assembly hangar: low rail-mounted quadruped/saurian chassis cradle and protected cyan reactors; no living workframe or T-Rex statue.

smith.subject: Large foreground framing street forge, weathered timber work roof and restrained orange furnace light.

engineers.subject: Stomper/Prismatic Workshop: grounded heavy shield-construct fabrication and protected crystal inspection apparatus; no forge-worker infantry dwelling.

tavern.subject: Large welcoming timber-and-stone craftworkers' inn, hanging sign and teal awning; part of the same street.

market.subject: Narrow foreground guild shop with varied cloth awnings, trade goods and a small civic seal; not a duplicate house.

exchange.subject: Large foreground cargo exchange and coach-service warehouse, painted shipping marks and side loading porch.

coast.subject: Intentional quay and moored-ship family only; landward door is on the dry front quay.

grail.subject: Small tall Progress Beacon with bronze Piltover crest/orbit sculpture, on its own dry civic landing beside the narrow eastern stair. Explicit optional seventeenth site; no hall-state dependency.

plate_rules: Sixteen ordinary land sites and exactly seven troop-tier sites; all35 states use full800x374 independent frames
Complete source material/shadow envelopes are measured across every state and remain disjoint
Foreground families enlarged15–25percent as requested subject to measured fixed maximum envelopes; middle10–15percent
Every public building door has a grounded stair/foundation and connected street approach; no levitating ground-access building
One optional coastal wooden/stone pier and moored ship intentionally over water, supported by pylons/gangway to dry main promenade
One optional separate Progress Orrery remains a dry civic monument
Own painted2D cyan lamps/brass conduits unify infrastructure; no completed functional architecture baked in background
Crest remains correct physical Piltover heraldry on cloth and civic architecture
review: V4 source composition reviewed by coordinator: larger front/middle forms, grounded cyan hextech infrastructure and supported over-water harbor connection. Actual SDK cold/repeat conversion and source privacy evidence separate from native/final art/rights acceptance.
